tone.voice: friendly and expert — like a knowledgeable friend who happens to be a beauty professional
tone.avoid: clinical, cold, overly technical, masculine-coded language

ux_norms: image-first layouts — large beautiful visuals dominate
calendar and time pickers are central UI elements
loyalty points and rewards commonly shown
horizontal scroll for categories and products

visual_language.style: soft, warm, high-key lighting — lifestyle and product focused
photography_rules: always show real people and real results
warm skin tones, natural lighting preferred
never use cold or harsh lighting
visual_language.background_treatment: soft warm whites, blush tones, subtle gradients — never harsh black
visual_language.empty_state_style: soft SVG illustration — flower, sparkle, or mirror motif with warm copy
visual_language.onboarding_visual: warm flat vector illustration or soft watercolor style
visual_language.illustration_style: when used: soft watercolor or flat pastel vector — never geometric or techy

compliance_notes: health claims must be carefully worded — avoid medical language
GDPR-compliant data handling for personal beauty profiles

avoid: Never use harsh or clinical language — warmth and care define this industry's tone
Never use before/after imagery without explicit consent disclosure
Never show body measurements or weight in a context that could trigger body image concerns
Never use red or aggressive colour accents — softness is the aesthetic
Never show a provider without their credentials and certifications prominently displayed
Never use stock photography of models — real client photography or illustrated placeholders only
enforce: Provider photo always shown prominently — trust is visual in this industry
Certification badges always visible on provider profile
Consultation notes always private and never shared without explicit consent
Cancellation policy always shown before booking confirmation
Product ingredients always listed where applicable — allergy awareness is mandatory
Review authenticity — verified purchase badge on every review
